title: Flash backup 3/5 - the LaunchPad wired for the clip read, reset held the cooker's way
source: Own photos, raptox's LaunchPad, stitched from photos 04-08 of 2026-11-05 (jumpers as delivered in the photo)
caption: The clip on U8 (no VCC lead), the reader's GND at J22. J9 on, the RST cap off, a hold lead from R321's chip-side pad to GND, J13 on SOP2. The USB goes in last: it powers the board.

terminals.label: Reader (Pi, Pico or FT232H): CS, CLK, MOSI, MISO, GND; drawings fb-reader-*
PC USB: plugged in after the hold is on, out before it comes off

callouts.label: U8: the clip, pin-1 lead on pin 1
callouts.note: flashrom 1.8.0 knows the part (checked 2026-11-06). Leads on pins 1, 2, 4, 5, 6; none on 3, 7, 8.

callouts.label: U8 pin 1 (CS#), bottom leg on the right
callouts.note: From the marking's orientation (read like the CC3220's, rotated): pin 1 is the bottom leg of the right side. Check: pin 4, the top leg of the same side, must beep to GND.

callouts.label: U8 pin 4 (GND): must beep to J22 GND
U8 pin 8 (VCC): no lead; 3.3 V when powered
callouts.note: The board feeds it from USB.

callouts.label: R321 and C322 (raptox found them; not legible here)
callouts.note: Near U7's pin-32 corner. Hold point = R321's pad that does NOT beep to J9 (the chip side, shared with C322). Find it with the beeper, not from this picture.

callouts.label: U7, the CC3220S: pin 32 (nRESET) at this corner
callouts.note: Pin-1 dot at the photo's bottom-left, so pin 32 sits at the top-right corner.

callouts.label: J9 (RST PU): jumper ON
callouts.note: Connects R321 to 3.3 V (raptox, J-206; TI SWRU463C 2.5.5): the cooker's pull-up.

callouts.label: J22 GND: the hold lead and the reader's GND
callouts.note: Printed GND. Nothing on J22's 3V3 pin.

callouts.label: RST cap: OFF (row 6 from the BRD-SENSE end)
callouts.note: Takes the XDS110 off nRESET, so nothing fights the hold. Back on afterwards. Row position from the photo.

callouts.label: J13: SOP2 only, for every clip read
callouts.note: If the hold slips, the ROM waits in its boot loader instead of starting the image. Never SOP1 and SOP0 together.

callouts.label: USB: in last, out first
callouts.note: It powers the board (and U8) for the read.

callouts.label: SW4 FRST: never pressed
callouts.note: Factory restore at reset: a write (SWRU463C table 8).
